conventions.eventsFnv1a: fnv1a32 of the event lines joined with '\n'
conventions.controllers: null = no controller (queued inputs + 5 s timeout only); {tier, think}: when ready, null until readyTicks >= think, then chooseMove(tier) on the side AI stream; the timeout auto-pick is chooseMove(normal) on the same stream
conventions.inputs: [tick, side, slot]: queueInput(side, slot) just before stepping that tick (invalid inputs are ignored when used)
conventions.setupAt: stats = statsAt(level) * powerPct / 100; moves = offline generator (stream 12, or 14 after a bloomer rebirth) with moveFactorPct(level), filtered by slotUnlockLevels
conventions.ngCheck: contains any of [ばか, しね]

warnings: slot 2 attribute must differ from slot 1
slot 4 (ひっさつ) is always neutral

expected.reason: slot 1 must be a damage move

input.note: つよい vs ふつう
よわい vs ふつう
さきどり: scripted taps (some invalid) + timeouts
no input at all: every move is the 5 s おまかせ
rated sync: pre-rebirth bloomer vs Lv7 kid (both at Lv50)
rated sync: reborn bloomer vs Lv50 kid
family: bloomer boosted past Lv50 keeps its pre-rebirth form
tanks: heat-up ramp and the 3-minute cap (HP ratio)
